'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[October 2024 Beit Lahia attacks]]
****[[Hamas]] claims that at least 73 [[Palestinians]] were killed in [[Israel]]i strikes on [[Beit Lahia]] in the [[Gaza Strip]], although the [[Israel Defence Forces]] dispute this claim. [https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/58/1262/533799/War-on-Gaza/War-on-Gaza/At-least--Palestinians-killed-in-Israeli-strikes-i.aspx (''Al Ahram'')]
***[[Refugee camp airstrikes in the Israel–Hamas war]]
****Israeli forces strike the Gaza Strip, killing at least 50 people, including at least 33 people in an airstrike on the [[Jabalia]] refugee camp. [https://www.npr.org/2024/10/19/nx-s1-5158375/netanyahu-house-drone-israel (NPR)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c8xez14e7lro (BBC News)]
*[[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)|Israel–Hezbollah conflict]]
**[[2024 drone attack on Benjamin Netanyahu's residence]]
***[[Hezbollah]] launches around 200 drones and other projectiles from [[Lebanon]] toward locations in northern [[Israel]], killing one person and injuring thirteen others. One of the targets is [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]]'s house in the resort town of [[Caesarea (modern town)|Caesarea]]. [https://www.startribune.com/strike-launched-toward-israeli-prime-ministers-house/601164698 (''Star Tribune'')] [https://apnews.com/article/israel-hamas-war-news-10-18-2024-c49911f11a40b7d81b21bc8568ecfe11 (AP)]
**[[2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon]]
***Israeli [[Airstrike|strikes]] on a vehicle and an apartment building in [[Baaloul]], Lebanon, and areas north of [[Beirut]], Lebanon, kill seven people, including the mayor of the town of [[Sohmor]]. [https://www.boston25news.com/news/world/drone-targets/GWI54MVZ6VHETEZBVQ2ZZQAZH4/ (Boston25 News)]
**The [[Israel Defense Forces]] says that the [[Israeli Air Force]] killed [[Hezbollah]]'s deputy commander Naser Abed al-Aziz Rashid in [[Bint Jbeil]], Lebanon, yesterday. [https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2024/oct/19/drone-targets-israeli-prime-ministers-house-as-str/ (''The Washington Times'')] [https://www.jpost.com/israel-news/article-825206 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Sapelo Island dock collapse]]
**At least seven people are killed and several others are reported missing when a [[dock]] collapses on [[Sapelo Island]] in [[Georgia (U.S. state)|Georgia]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/ferry-dock-collapse-deaths-sapelo-island-georgia-66ea381cb0f9fd697fc51fc7aa853038 (AP)] 

'''Law and crime'''
*Protesters storm and damage the office of the [[Saudi Arabia|Saudi]]-owned [[MBC Group|MBC]] TV channel in [[Baghdad]], [[Iraq]], after the channel aired a programme which called [[Hamas]] and [[Hezbollah]] leaders "terrorists". The [[Communications and Media Commission (Iraq)|Iraq Communications and Media Commission]] later suspends MBC's operations in Iraq in response to the incident. [https://www.newarab.com/news/iraqi-protesters-storm-wreck-office-saudi-owned-mbc-channel (New Arab)] [https://en.royanews.tv/news/55053 (Roya News)]
*Three people are killed and eight others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] when at least two gunmen opened fire on people at a school's football homecoming win celebration in near [[Lexington, Mississippi|Lexington]], [[Mississippi]], [[United States]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mississippi-mass-shooting-homecoming-abaab1bfceadaefe8c67c25e51f778f9 (AP)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Intelsat]] [[communications satellite]] [[Intelsat 33e]] breaks up in [[Earth's orbit]], resulting in network disruptions to customers in Europe, Africa and parts of the Asia-Pacific region. The [[United States Space Force]] says they are tracking at least "20 associated pieces" of the satellite. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ce8d886l028o (BBC News)]
